prayer_1.name: TheBiblesQuotes
prayer_1.context: “Father, we ask that You move the hearts of faithful believers to support and fund this site. Let it be a beacon of truth where Your Word is rightly divided, shared without distortion, and offered freely to all who seek You.”

prayer_7wy2.name: BadNintendo
prayer_7wy2.context: Pray that all social media platforms uphold the same standards of accountability as we expect from our communities without loopholes or double standards. Far too often, deceivers and corrupt networks are allowed to thrive despite platforms having the means to filter them out. If you’ve ever been spammed or seen cloned accounts linger for months (or even years) after being reported, you’re not alone. The signs are everywhere-just open your eyes.

prayer_32pxl.name: BadNintendo
prayer_32pxl.context: A friend who is in need of custody needs attention from the Lord, If the ex which has children with her won't allow the kids to leave without court order to keep them, pray that the proper authority and hands of God are placed upon all those who need it to ensure the children are in the proper place best for them regardless of the outcome. The little I know about Courtney she is trying her best to hold it together and be strong. If in a moment of praying hope, you can find time to include this in yours.
